extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: A land use and land cover classification dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images, covering 13 spectral bands and 10 classes with 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced image patches.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber; Benjamin Bischke; Andreas Dengel; Damian Borth
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images were downloaded from Sentinel-2A via Amazon S3 for cities covered in the European Urban Atlas across over 34 European countries. From these images, 27,000 geo-referenced and labeled 64x64 image patches were created and manually checked.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The authors state that they manually checked all 27,000 images multiple times and corrected the ground truth by sorting out mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice. They also selected satellite images with a low cloud level to improve the chance of getting valuable image patches.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Openly and freely accessible Sentinel-2A satellite images from the Copernicus Earth observation program, downloaded via Amazon S3 and associated with cities covered in the European Urban Atlas.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Images were recorded all over the year.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Image patches of size 64x64 pixels were extracted from satellite images to create the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Satellite images with low cloud level were selected. All 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times, and mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice were removed. The dataset did not receive atmospheric correction, and samples with color cast due to atmospheric effects were retained. Lower-resolution bands were upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation for band evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset consists of labeled image patches for 10 land use and land cover classes. Ground truth labels were manually checked multiple times and corrected by removing mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The authors note low positive correlation between classes, with the most common confusions between agricultural classes and between residential and industrial buildings; the classifier confusion matrix also shows confusion between agricultural classes and highway versus river.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Geography/location information through geo-referenced images distributed over European cities in 34 countries.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset and resulting classification system are intended to support Earth observation applications such as agriculture, disaster recovery, climate change, urban development, environmental monitoring, land use and land cover change detection, nature protection, sustainable development, and improving geographical maps.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset distribution is influenced by the number of represented cities per country in the European Urban Atlas. The authors also aimed to cover as many countries as possible and images from all over the year to capture high intra-class variance.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has not received atmospheric correction, which can cause color cast. Some samples with atmospheric effects were intentionally retained. The 10-meter spatial resolution limits class visibility to those discernible at that resolution, and the patch-based classifier does not allow finely graduated per-pixel segmentation.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended as a benchmark and training basis for land use and land cover classification with deep neural networks, and for real-world Earth observation applications including change detection and map updating.
